text: Nneka's transfer arrives, but it names no invoice at all.
Zainab opens the chat's tools, then taps Money.
She taps To match: money that is not on an invoice yet.
She opens Nneka's payment: ₦85,000, from her bank transfer.
Tap Match to an invoice, then pick the one it pays: INV-0008.
Tap Match it, and the payment counts towards INV-0008.
Back in Invoices, INV-0008 for Nneka Eze now shows Paid.
